findings.claim: The landmark_00_local_dx coordinate proxy is non-monotone over the full observed window [0.0,0.49]: it rises from a near-zero start to a positive peak near t≈0.11, then falls to a negative trough near t≈0.19, and returns toward small positive values by t≈0.49. The whole-window mean is slightly negative (whole_window_z=-0.184), so the endpoint value alone does not represent the mid-window excursion.

The observed-node linear trend for landmark_00_local_dx has a strongly negative early rate (first_rate_z=-17.49) and a strongly positive late rate (last_rate_z=+8.11), with 6 sign changes and 9 strong sign conflicts across 14 independent batches. This is a changing-contrast profile, not a stationary target, and the quadratic polynomial fit was not accepted (polynomial_accepted=false, relative_node_RMSE=0.78).

The score clock is defined over observed score nodes 0.0 to 0.49 with learning window [0.0,0.5] and curve support [0.0,0.49]; recorded affinities were removed and an equal score prior applies, so decoded final affinity is unobserved in this input.

hypotheses.direction: early-weighted dose targets the positive-going phase; late-weighted dose targets the recovery phase
hypotheses.falsifier: If realized per-node dose is audited and the early- and late-weighted schedules produce indistinguishable landmark_00_local_dx trajectories over [0.0,0.49], the phase-specific hypothesis fails.
hypotheses.statement: A dose schedule that concentrates guidance early in the observed score window would act on the rising phase of landmark_00_local_dx, whereas a schedule concentrating guidance late would act on the post-trough recovery phase; the two are not interchangeable because the coordinate contrast changes sign within the window.

hypotheses.direction: no fixed absolute target; time-varying contrast only
hypotheses.falsifier: If an independently stable profile shows a monotone or stationary landmark_00_local_dx over the full window, a fixed target could be reconsidered.
hypotheses.statement: Because landmark_00_local_dx is non-monotone with a mid-window negative excursion, a single absolute coordinate target for this proxy is not supported by the observed curve; only a time-varying contrast description is warranted.

limitations: Only one coordinate proxy (landmark_00_local_dx) was read; the remaining 199 curve features were not inspected, so cross-coordinate consistency is unassessed.
Stage profiles and temporal profiles are unavailable; no stage boundary or data-derived knot is supported by this input.
Decoded final affinity labels are unobserved (recorded affinities removed, equal score prior), so selection preference cannot be equated with descendant survival or measured final benefit.
The quadratic polynomial fit was not accepted and the curve has 6 sign changes with 9 strong sign conflicts, so any smooth parametric summary of this proxy is unreliable.
No dose or reward edit is justified by this evidence alone; the registered recipes are proposed interventions, not parameters learned from the observed slope.
